title: The season passes. The caravan comes too late: the year has turned and the standing at ʿArafāt has gone by, the afternoon beneath the Mount of Mercy that is the Hajj itself. The month among the scholars of al-Azhar cost the Emperor the pilgrimage. The caravan disperses and turns for home; the journey must be made again from the beginning

data.event: The Royal Ḥajj: The Season Passed
data.choice: We tarried too long. It must be undertaken again.
data.calendar: the game counts the season as over by 6 January 1386; the chronicle's tabular reckoning had put ʿArafa near 11 January, so the game's Hajj calendar runs earlier than the arithmetic one

source: Trent's screenshot of the event, 6 January 1386

title: Misfortune turns to fortune on the road home: the Emperor recruits many of the scholars of al-Azhar he sat with to fill the halls of the capital. The Jamāʿa must be persuaded to fund them, and the ʿulamāʾ back the measure: sponsor theological seminaries. The Jamāʿa passes it: the realm gains theological seminaries for ten years

data.date: on the way home from the Hajj, early 1386; the day awaits a save
data.outcome: passed (Trent's account): Theological Seminaries for 10 years, +10% research, +0.01 literacy a month, +2 Innovative
